# Premium External Design Reference Library

These sources are meant for **pattern study and inspiration**, not direct cloning.

## Highest-priority libraries

1. **21st.dev - component registry**  
   https://21st.dev/  
   Use for high-quality React interactions/components that can be brought into an agentic coding workflow.

2. **21st.dev - Multi-Step Form**  
   https://21st.dev/community/components/ravikatiyar/multi-step-form/default  
   Study progress, navigation, validation, contained width, and transitions.

3. **21st.dev - Multi-step Wizard**  
   https://21st.dev/community/components/dhiluxui/multi-step-wizard  
   Study responsive onboarding behavior and clear step status.

4. **21st onboarding guide**  
   https://docs.21st.dev/blog/react-onboarding-stepper-components  
   Strong UX guidance: reduce friction, show step totals, persist state, allow back navigation.

5. **SaaSFrame - UI/UX screen library**  
   https://www.saasframe.io/  
   Browse: User Onboarding, Search, Details, Empty State, Loading, Account Setup.

6. **SaaSFrame - Search screens**  
   https://www.saasframe.io/search-screens  
   Study search prominence and real shipped patterns.

7. **SaaS Interface**  
   https://saasinterface.com/  
   Browse Directory, Onboarding, Profile/User, Item Details, Search, Filters.

8. **SaaSUI**  
   https://www.saasui.design/  
   Useful because examples come from real shipped software rather than only concept art.

9. **Refero**  
   https://refero.design/apps  
   Search for onboarding, personalization, search, directory, company/profile, Airbnb.

10. **Land-book**  
    https://land-book.com/  
    Use mainly for landing-page composition. Filter toward SaaS, community, education, cards, light/Apple-style interfaces.

11. **Lapa Ninja**  
    https://www.lapa.ninja/  
    Use for landing page rhythm, hero typography, feature sections, whitespace.

12. **Row.so**  
    https://row.so/  
    Useful directory-product reference: card grid, filters, custom listing fields, featured entries.

13. **EmbedDirectory filterable grid**  
    https://embeddirectory.com/product/filterable-grid  
    Good reference for search/filter behavior and card-grid adaptation.

14. **Activity Hub**  
    https://www.activityhub.org/  
    Directly relevant campus-engagement product; study positioning and student-first framing.

15. **Gathr**  
    https://getgathr.app/  
    Direct campus discovery reference, including personalization by interests/major.

16. **VibeLink**  
    https://try-vibelink.com/  
    Direct campus club discovery reference. Useful competitively, but ClubMatch should feel more premium and more personalized.

17. **Club Up (UH Manoa)**  
    https://clubmeetup.github.io/  
    Useful for seeing a traditional centralized student-club directory and understanding what ClubMatch should improve upon.

18. **Club Hub design case study**  
    https://dylanjonwan.com/club-hub  
    Relevant student-club discovery UX case study.

## Pattern references / visual concepts

19. **Modern Search Input UI (Dribbble)**  
    https://dribbble.com/shots/26367973-Modern-Search-Input-UI  
    Search prominence, subtle grouping, filter tabs, restrained light UI.

20. **Onboarding Preferences / Interest Selection (Dribbble)**  
    https://dribbble.com/shots/25855383-Onboarding-Preferences-Interest-Selection  
    Clear multi-select cards with selected state and progress.

21. **Event App Onboarding Flow (Dribbble)**  
    https://dribbble.com/shots/26773331-Event-App-Onboarding-Flow-UI  
    Interest-selection flow for personalized event discovery.

22. **Community Cards (Dribbble)**  
    https://dribbble.com/shots/17558901-Community-Cards  
    Community/club card anatomy, member/social metadata, Join/View action hierarchy.

23. **Vercel design/performance article**  
    https://vercel.com/blog/how-we-made-the-vercel-dashboard-twice-as-fast  
    General Vercel visual restraint and shipped-product polish.

24. **Airbnb help / search mental model**  
    https://www.airbnb.com/help/article/39  
    Study the discovery mental model: criteria -> ranked results -> card -> detail.

25. **Pinterest**  
    https://www.pinterest.com/  
    Study personalization and discovery density; use searches such as `interest selection onboarding ui`, `directory filter ui`, `premium card ui`.

## Search terms that produce useful references
- personalization onboarding UI
- interest selection onboarding
- directory filter UI
- marketplace search cards
- Airbnb filter UI
- community discovery app
- recommendation card UI
- organization profile UI
- search results web app
- interest chips UI
- multi step preference form
- premium light SaaS
- minimal directory UI
- responsive card grid
- empty state discovery
